speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To understand your condition better, have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as increased frequency, urgency, or blood in the urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis.

Your symptoms of fever, flank pain, and fatigue persisting after a sinus infection, combined with your lack of urinary changes, suggest a possible alternative diagnosis or a concurrent issue. Given the location of your pain and the systemic signs of infection, could you describe the exact nature of the pain (e.g., sharp, dull, radiating) and whether you have any history of kidney stones or urinary tract infections?
